about: Hand-written rotation guides for the shaman's player pages (guides.py).

raid.plan: **Lightning Bolt** fills every gap. Around it you keep a **Searing Totem** down and **Flame Shock** ticking, and cast **Chain Lightning** when two or more enemies stand together or when your mana is ahead of the time left. You play the same list from pull to kill. The official simulator ships no Elemental rotation, so this is the project's own: built on the deleted ElliotWood/Forever fork's preset and tuned in a full raid in 17 passes from 2026-09-28 to 2026-11-17; the play check of 2026-11-20 took out two lines that cast nothing (Lava Burst, no longer in Forever's spellbook, and an id the simulator does not know). This 29/22/0 build takes no **Lightning Mastery**. In a 3-minute raid fight: **Lightning Bolt** 68 casts, **Chain Lightning** 13, **Flame Shock** 9, **Searing Totem** 4; **Lightning Bolt** 68% of the damage, **Chain Lightning** 14%, **Flame Shock** 13%, **Searing Totem** 4%.
why: **Searing Totem** first: a new one when the old has 2 seconds or less left, so it never lapses (it lasts 55 seconds, 4 a fight), but none in the last 10 seconds. It shoots an enemy within 20 yards; the simulator stands you 15 yards from the boss. It is 4% of your damage, with **Call of Flame**'s 15% and **Elemental Fury**'s bigger crits on it.

**Flame Shock** whenever it is off the boss: 13% of your damage. With 3 points in **Call of Flame** it lasts 21 seconds and hits 15% harder, so it is recast about every 21 seconds; the shocks' cooldown (5.6 seconds with 2 points in **Reverberation**) never holds it up.

Then your cooldowns and a potion: the simulated gear's trinkets (Talisman of Ephemeral Power twice a fight, Weakness Analyzer once) and a Demonic Rune (twice) whenever ready, a Major Mana Potion below 80% mana (about twice). This build has no class cooldown on that line.

**Chain Lightning** (6-second cooldown) on two or more targets whenever it is ready, and on one target while your mana is at least 50 for every second of the fight left (3,000 mana with a minute to go): 13 casts, 14% of your damage. On one target it deals about 8% more per cast than a **Lightning Bolt** in the same 2 seconds (this build's full-raid damage per cast), but costs 315 mana against 220, so on one target the list casts it only while you have mana to spare by that rule. Our rotation search lowered the threshold from 100 to 50 a second on 2026-11-04 (+2.2% on two seeds), and the list no longer saves Clearcasting for **Chain Lightning**.

**Lightning Bolt** is the filler, 68 casts and 68% of your damage, at the top rank (rank 10); the list drops to rank 8 only when it cannot pay for rank 10, 0.2 casts a fight in a full raid. **Elemental Alacrity** (3 points) makes **Lightning Bolt** and **Chain Lightning** 2-second casts. Start the first **Lightning Bolt** 2 seconds before the pull so it lands as the fight starts.

The rest of the build feeds the bolts: **Concussion** adds 5% to **Lightning Bolt** and **Chain Lightning**, **Call of Thunder** and **Thundering Strikes** 5% crit each, **Elemental Fury** (4 points) 80% to your crit bonus (a spell crit deals 190% instead of 150%), **Lightning Overload** a 30% chance of a second, half-damage copy at no cost, and **Elemental Focus** sometimes makes your next damage spell free. **Convection** and **Shamanistic Focus** cut your mana costs. From Enhancement, **Ancestral Knowledge** adds 10% Intellect and **Mental Quickness** turns up to 30% of your Intellect into spell damage. **Eye of the Storm**, **Earth's Grasp**, **Anticipation** and **Toughness** are there to reach the next tiers: the simulator finds no change without any of them.
caveats: **Lightning Overload** on **Chain Lightning**: in the simulator each target it hits rolls its own copy at a third of **Lightning Bolt**'s chance; the tooltip gives both 30%.

Several targets: with two or more enemies close together the list casts **Chain Lightning** whenever it is ready (3 targets, each jump 30% weaker), and once your Fire totem has run out it drops a **Magma Totem** instead of a **Searing Totem**: 20 seconds, hitting enemies within 8 yards of it, at your feet.

Mana: in a full raid the list almost never runs short in 3 minutes: it falls back to rank 8 **Lightning Bolt** 0.2 times a fight. Without a raid's mana buffs, or in a longer fight, the **Chain Lightning** rule spends less on its own, as long as you count the time left right.

Your other totems: the simulated full raid already counts **Mana Spring Totem**, **Strength of Earth Totem** and **Windfury Totem** as up, so this list drops only your Fire totem. If you are your group's shaman, drop what your group needs at the pull: they last 5 minutes.

Ranks: the list casts **Flame Shock** at rank 5, the trainer's top rank: rank 6 comes from a class book that is not in Forever on the evidence there is (2026-11-20; checked again when the raids open on 2026-12-09).
Moving: **Flame Shock** (20 yards) and your totems are instant; the bolts are not.
diverge: In the last 10 seconds, do not drop a new **Searing Totem**: it would shoot only a few times. Cast a **Lightning Bolt** instead.
On a boss that lives much longer than 3 minutes, count the real time left for the **Chain Lightning** rule: counted against a shorter fight, it spends mana you will need later.
If the boss will die before a 2-second cast can finish, only an instant still lands: an **Earth Shock** hits harder at once than **Flame Shock** (the two share a cooldown).

If you play one of the 31-point builds under Other builds (32/11/8 or 31/11/9), press Lightning Mastery whenever it is ready (3-minute cooldown, about once a fight in the simulator): for 15 seconds it takes 0.5 seconds off each **Lightning Bolt** and removes **Chain Lightning**'s cooldown.

leveling.plan: Kill as much as you can with **Lightning Bolt** before the mob reaches you, then use your shocks whenever they are ready and bolt between them while your mana holds. Mana is the limit: about a third of each kill is drinking in the fight lab.
why: **Lightning Shield** before each pull: it strikes a mob each time it hits you, one ball every few seconds; about 10% of your damage at 60 in the fight lab (2026-11-15). **Shamanistic Focus** (level 28) makes it and your shocks 45% cheaper: the build's most valuable talent at 60 (about 3 seconds per kill without it).

**Lightning Bolt** while the mob walks in: nothing pushes those casts back. Once the mob hits you, each hit pushes a cast back (about 3 times per kill in the fight lab); **Eye of the Storm** (levels 44-46) cuts that by 70%. **Elemental Alacrity** (34-36) takes half a second off the cast.

The shocks share one cooldown and cannot be pushed back. **Flame Shock** goes first while it is not ticking and the mob is above 30% health (**Call of Flame**, 37-38 and 40, strengthens it and makes it last longer); **Earth Shock** takes every other shock, and comes first whenever it would kill. **Convection** (29-33) makes shocks and bolts 10% cheaper.
**Elemental Fury** (levels 54-58) doubles the crit bonus of your spells and **Searing Totem**.

Bolt between shocks only while you keep the mana for the next **Earth Shock** and **Flame Shock**; otherwise let your weapon swing. The fight lab keeps **Rockbiter Weapon** on (from 30 **Windfury Weapon**, and from 50 **Rockbiter Weapon** again: 0.4% faster per kill at 50 and 1% at 60, the tune of 2026-11-17), and your weapon does about an eighth of your damage at 60.
Drop **Searing Totem** at each pull while you have more than half your mana: it does about 6% of your damage at 60.
caveats: From 39, **Elemental Focus** sometimes makes your next damage spell free: nothing to change, the next spell in the list takes it.
This list is for one mob at a time; the fight lab does not model area pulls for Elemental. **Chain Lightning** hits up to 3 targets if you pull more.

Levels 10-17 go into Restoration (**Tidal Focus**: 5% more chance to hit; **Mindfulness**: half your mana regeneration continues while you cast) and 18-28 into Enhancement (**Thundering Strikes**: 5% crit with spells and attacks; **Mental Dexterity** (23-25): attack power from your Intellect; **Improved Lightning Shield** (26-27): more damage from **Lightning Shield**; the last two mostly open the tier of **Shamanistic Focus** at 28, which makes shocks and **Lightning Shield** 45% cheaper). From 29 every point goes to Elemental.

Between pulls heal back to 80% health, eat if you are still under 90% and drink only below 15% mana, and whenever you sit down for one, take the other too: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17; eating at 90%, against 80% before, was 1-2.5% faster per kill at every level from 20).
diverge: A nearly dead mob: an instant **Earth Shock** finishes it before another bolt could land.
A caster mob that stays back: **Earth Shock** interrupts it and locks that school for 2 seconds, which brings it to you.
A bad pull (you under 30% health): **Stoneclaw Totem** taunts the mob onto itself, then heal with **Lesser Healing Wave**; the fight lab does this for every shaman.
A mob that flees: **Frost Shock** slows it by 50% for 8 seconds (it shares the shock cooldown).

raid.plan: Enhancement is a melee spec that spends mana: your two-hander and **Windfury Weapon** do the most damage, and you fill the gaps between swings with **Flame Shock**, **Stormstrike**, **Magma Totem**, instant **Maelstrom Weapon** bolts, **Earth Shock** and **Fire Nova**, in that order. Mana is the limit, so the list puts the cheap and free casts first, saves **Magma Totem** for when you have a quarter of your mana, and casts **Fire Nova**, a 375-mana spell, last.
why: Before the pull, drop **Strength of Earth Totem**, **Grace of Air Totem** and **Searing Totem** (one by one, or all at once with **Call of the Elements**). In Forever the first two last 5 minutes, so one cast covers the fight. Grace of Air rather than **Windfury Totem**: your own **Windfury Weapon** switches Windfury Totem off for you (the imbue's tooltip), and you can keep only one Air totem down.

**Flame Shock** goes on the target whenever it is off and at least 10 seconds of the fight are left (it lasts 21 seconds with **Call of Flame**; keeping it up measured about 1% better), so most presses go to **Stormstrike**: it costs only 8% of your base mana, hits for 100% of your weapon damage (150% before the 2026-11-10 hotfix) and makes your next **Lightning Bolt**, **Chain Lightning** or **Earth Shock** deal 20% more for 12 seconds. With **Improved Stormstrike** each one also keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast for 15 seconds, so on its 8-second cooldown that never drops, and a dodge or parry resets the cooldown. In the simulator's removal runs it is 18% of the build, its most valuable talent.

**Magma Totem** replaces **Searing Totem** once the fight starts (one Fire totem at a time): it burns everything within 8 yards for 73 Fire damage every 2 seconds, and **Trial by Fire** stretches it to 40 seconds, so about 4 or 5 a fight. It costs 650 mana: drop it at the boss's feet whenever it is down while you have a quarter of your mana; below that, **Searing Totem** fills the gap.

**Flame Shock** and **Earth Shock** share one cooldown (6 seconds, 5.2 with your 4 points in **Reverberation**), and **Shamanistic Focus** makes both 45% cheaper. Every shock that is not a Flame Shock is an **Earth Shock**: about 23 a fight and your biggest spell, 5% stronger with **Concussion** and 20% with **Stormstrike**.
**Lightning Bolt** only at 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**: 5 stacks make the bolt instant and free. Waiting for the full stack measured better than casting at 3.

**Fire Nova** erupts around your Fire totem, not around you, so keep the totem within 10 yards of the boss. Adding Fire Nova measured about 7% more damage in the rotation search. With **Trial by Fire** it hits 20% harder and its cooldown is 6 seconds (10 without), about 24 casts a fight; it is not a true filler: the list casts it with at least 10% mana, and when nothing is ready you keep swinging.

Your Elemental points: **Elemental Devastation** turns each spell crit into 9% more melee crit chance for 10 seconds, which feeds **Flurry** (10% of the build in the removal runs); **Call of Flame** adds 15% to your Fire spells and totems; **Elemental Focus** makes a damage spell free now and then. The two Restoration points are **Tidal Focus**: 2% more chance to hit.

Put **Windfury Weapon** on your two-hander with an Elemental Sharpening Stone on top: in Forever an imbue and a stone stack. Its extra attacks are about a sixth of your damage, and your point in **Elemental Weapons** makes them 13% stronger. Keep it on: the re-tune of 2026-11-17 measured **Rockbiter Weapon** about 10% worse in a full raid. Press **Rage of the Farseer** (30% attack speed for 25 seconds) at the pull with your trinkets and potion.
caveats: Mana runs short: with only your own buffs the simulator's build runs out of mana for a few seconds of a 3-minute fight. Do not hold shocks in reserve (casting **Earth Shock** freely measured 3% better than keeping 60% of your mana, on the training dummy), and use a mana potion and a Demonic Rune when low. Clearcasting from **Elemental Focus** makes your next damage spell free: nothing to change, the next line takes it.

Several targets: **Magma Totem** and **Fire Nova** hit every enemy within 8 and 10 yards of your Fire totem, so they gain the most from adds. You can have only one Fire totem out at a time; if the adds stand away from it, **Totemic Call** brings it to you, with all your other totems.
**Maelstrom Weapon**'s proc rate is not published. The stacks last 30 seconds, so cast the bolt when you reach 5.
Forced out of melee range? A 5-stack **Lightning Bolt** (instant) and the shocks (20 yards) still land.

The page's full-raid number has no party **Windfury Totem**: in Forever your own **Windfury Weapon** switches it off for you (the imbue's tooltip), and since 2026-11-18 the simulator's full raid leaves it out for this spec, which took about 12% off the number (the build still leads).
diverge: In the last 10 seconds, skip **Flame Shock**: its burn would not finish. Use the shock on **Earth Shock** instead.
If the fight runs past 3 minutes, press **Rage of the Farseer** again as soon as it is ready.

In a party of warriors and rogues, ask whether they want **Windfury Totem** instead of **Grace of Air Totem**: you can keep only one Air totem down, and Windfury Totem does nothing for you while you use **Windfury Weapon**.

leveling.plan: Melee with a slow two-hander and your weapon imbue (**Windfury Weapon** from 30, **Rockbiter Weapon** again from 40), and use your spells to finish mobs rather than to open on them: every spell costs mana, and mana costs drinking time.
why: Before every pull: **Lightning Shield** and your imbue: **Rockbiter Weapon** until 30, **Windfury Weapon** from 30, **Rockbiter Weapon** again from 40 (its attack power counts on every swing and **Stormstrike**: 0.4% faster per kill than Windfury at 40 and 1.2% at 50 in the rules re-tuned on 2026-11-16, after the hotfix that cut **Mental Dexterity** to 100% of your Intellect). At 60 in the fight lab your swings do about 30% of your damage, and **Lightning Shield** with **Improved Lightning Shield** (levels 18, 19 and 21) about 12%, because a mob hits you all fight.
**Searing Totem** at the pull while you have more than half your mana: it shoots the mob all fight, a few percent of your damage at 60.

**Stormstrike** (level 25) whenever it is ready: a weapon hit (100% weapon damage since the 2026-11-10 hotfix, 150% before) that makes your next **Earth Shock** or **Lightning Bolt** 20% stronger, and with **Improved Stormstrike** (38-39) half your mana regeneration continues while you cast. At 60 it is worth about 3 seconds per kill in the fight lab, second only to **Shamanistic Focus**.

One tuned rule shapes the fight: no **Lightning Bolt** until the mob is under 35% health, so no opening bolt, and a 5-stack bolt finishes the mob. The fight lab measured it about 10% faster per kill (re-tuned 2026-10-20).
**Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free: about a third of your damage at 60. It shares that cooldown with **Flame Shock**, so the fight lab never casts **Flame Shock** on one mob.

**Maelstrom Weapon** (levels 40-44) stacks as you hit: since the 2026-11-10 hotfix each stack takes 20% off your next **Lightning Bolt**'s cast time and mana at every rank, and more points bring the stacks faster, so 5 stacks make it instant and free. **Rage of the Farseer** (45) goes at the start of a fight whenever it is ready.
caveats: **Shamanistic Focus** (at 20) makes shocks and **Lightning Shield** 45% cheaper; at 60 it is worth about 4 seconds per kill in the fight lab, the most of any talent in this build.
Before 25 you have no **Stormstrike** and before 40 no **Maelstrom Weapon**: until then it is weapon, shield, **Earth Shock** and **Searing Totem**.
**Anticipation** (22 and 24) and **Elemental Weapons** (23) mostly fill the 15 Enhancement points that **Stormstrike**'s row asks for before you can take it at 25.

Between pulls heal back to 80% health, eat if you are still under 90% and drink only below 15% mana, and whenever you sit down for one, take the other too: it costs no extra time (the tuned rules of 2026-11-17). Below level 24 eat only under 80%: there the 90% line sits you down after almost every kill, 9-10% slower per kill at 20-22 in the fight lab; from 26 on it is faster.
diverge: A caster mob that stays back: **Earth Shock** interrupts it and locks that school for 2 seconds, which brings it to you.
Do not spend a 5-stack **Lightning Bolt** on a mob your next swing will kill: the stacks last 30 seconds and may carry over to the next pull.
A mob that flees at low health: **Earth Shock** finishes it, or **Frost Shock** slows it by 50%.

raid.plan: Heal the tank with **Healing Wave** at the rank that covers what it is missing, keep **Riptide** rolling on it, and switch to **Chain Heal** when three or more of your group are hurt; **Lesser Healing Wave** is for heals that must land fast. Mana decides how long you last, so **Water Shield**, **Mana Tide Totem** and a mana potion belong to the rotation.
why: **Healing Wave** is your main heal: **Healing Way** adds 25%, and it heals the most per point of mana of your cast heals. In the healer lab's fight (one tank and four raid members for five minutes) it does about three quarters of your healing. It takes 3 seconds (this build skips **Improved Healing Wave**), so start it early.

Cast the rank that covers the missing health, no more: the healer lab picks the lowest rank that heals 90% of it, and overhealing is wasted mana. Forever gives ranks far below your level less from healing power (the exact rule is not published; the lab assumes TBC's), but ranks learned at 48 or later keep all of it, so drop a rank or two, not to rank 1.

**Riptide** is instant and heals over 15 seconds; it has a 12-second cooldown. Keep it on the tank and use it on a hurt raid member or as a quick first heal when it is ready; a **Chain Heal** that starts on a target with your Riptide heals that target 25% more.

**Chain Heal** heals three targets for 100%, 50% and 25% of its amount, so it pays only when three people are hurt: the lab casts it when three group members are under half health. Cast on a party member, it jumps only to party members.
**Lesser Healing Wave** lands in 1.5 seconds but heals less per point of mana: it is the emergency heal for someone under 35% when **Riptide** is on cooldown, and the top-up for small gaps.
Drop **Healing Stream Totem** at the pull: it heals your whole group every 2 seconds for 5 minutes, and with **Restorative Totems** it did about a tenth of the healing in the lab.
caveats: Mana runs out before healing power does. Keep **Water Shield** up: each of its 3 globes returns 2% of your maximum mana when you are hit or any of your spells crits, at most one every few seconds (the lab and the community simulator use 3.5). It costs nothing and has no cooldown, so recast it whenever the globes are gone.

**Totemic Focus** (5 points, 25% cheaper totems) and **Mindfulness** (half your mana regeneration continues while you cast) are the build's mana points, and they also count toward the tier gates in front of **Water Shield** and **Mana Tide Totem**; the healer lab values the gate points low.

Drop **Mana Tide Totem** at about half mana: it restores 290 mana every 3 seconds for 12 seconds to everyone in your group within 30 yards, on a 5-minute cooldown. The lab also measured drinking a mana potion early (below 80% mana) better than saving it, since its 2-minute cooldown starts sooner.
Let raid members drop to about half health before you heal them: the healer lab measured that better than healing them at 70%.
The healer lab is a model of one group (a tank and four raid members) under stated assumptions; real raids spread damage differently.
diverge: **Nature's Swiftness** makes your next Nature spell instant (3-minute cooldown): save it for a tank under 35% health and pair it with a top-rank **Healing Wave**. It measured small in the lab (0.4%) because emergencies are rare there; keep it for the moment someone would otherwise die.
When three or more of your group take damage together, switch from **Healing Wave** to **Chain Heal**, starting on a target with your **Riptide**.
If your group needs mana more than healing (several casters), **Mana Spring Totem** is the other water totem; the lab only models **Healing Stream Totem**.

leveling.plan: You level with the raid healer's talents in the fastest order and play a simple melee shaman: a weapon imbue, a shield, **Searing Totem** at each pull and **Earth Shock** whenever the shock cooldown is free. It is about 40% slower than leveling as Enhancement (38 against 27 seconds per kill in the fight lab, levels 20-60, level-weighted): the price of arriving at 60 ready to heal.
why: This build takes none of Enhancement's melee talents (the "Not in this build" line names them): skip the lines that use them. In the fight lab it opens no fight with a **Lightning Bolt**: the tuned rule allows a bolt only once the mob is under 35% health, and with no Maelstrom Weapon there is no instant one.
**Earth Shock** takes every free shock (it shares the cooldown with **Flame Shock**, which the list therefore never reaches on one mob), and it interrupts a caster mob.

Your damage is your weapon: **Rockbiter Weapon** until 30, **Windfury Weapon** from 30 and **Rockbiter Weapon** again from 40, on a slow two-hander, and **Lightning Shield** strikes back each time a mob hits you. From 28 you also have **Water Shield**: when your shield is gone and you are under 60% mana, the fight lab puts up Water Shield instead (only one shield can be up).

The first points are **Tidal Focus** (10-14: 5% more chance to hit), **Mindfulness** (15-17) and **Thundering Strikes** (18-22: 5% crit); **Totemic Focus** (23-27) makes **Searing Totem** a quarter cheaper. Drop it at each pull while you have more than half your mana.
Low on health: **Stoneclaw Totem** taunts the mob onto itself for a few hits, then **Lesser Healing Wave**. From 35, **Nature's Swiftness** makes a **Healing Wave** instant when you drop under 30%.
caveats: Level this way if you want to heal dungeons on the way; if you only quest, level as Enhancement and respec at 60.
**Mana Tide Totem** (from 30) has a 5-minute cooldown: the fight lab does not use it while soloing.

Between pulls heal back to 80% health, eat if you are still under 90% and drink only below 15% mana, and whenever you sit down for one, take the other too: it costs no extra time (the Enhancement rules of 2026-11-17, which this page plays; eating at 90% was 2-3% faster per kill at 24-40).
diverge: A caster mob that stays back: **Earth Shock** interrupts it and locks that school for 2 seconds, which brings it to you.
A mob that flees at low health: **Earth Shock** finishes it, or **Frost Shock** slows it by 50% (both share the shock cooldown).

raid.plan: This hybrid is a melee shaman: Enhancement's **Stormstrike**, **Flurry** and **Maelstrom Weapon** with Elemental's **Elemental Devastation**, **Call of Flame** and **Trial by Fire**. It plays the Enhancement raid list: **Flame Shock**, **Stormstrike**, **Magma Totem**, an instant **Lightning Bolt** at 5 **Maelstrom Weapon** stacks, **Earth Shock** and **Fire Nova** between your swings, which with **Windfury Weapon** do the most damage.
why: Before the pull, drop **Strength of Earth Totem**, **Grace of Air Totem** and **Searing Totem**; the first two last 5 minutes, so one cast covers the fight.

**Stormstrike** is your main button: 8% of your base mana, a hit for 100% of your weapon damage and 20% more on your next **Lightning Bolt**, **Chain Lightning** or **Earth Shock**; with **Improved Stormstrike** each one keeps half your mana regeneration going while you cast for 15 seconds.

**Flame Shock** whenever the burn is off the target, **Earth Shock** on every other free shock. Your Elemental points shape them: 3 points in **Reverberation** bring the shared cooldown to 5.4 seconds, **Concussion** adds 5% to **Earth Shock** and your bolts, **Shamanistic Focus** makes them 45% cheaper, and **Call of Flame** adds 15% to **Flame Shock**, **Fire Nova** and your Fire totems.
**Lightning Bolt** only at 5 stacks of **Maelstrom Weapon**, when it is instant and free. This build takes 4 of the 5 points, so the stacks come a little slower than in the Enhancement build.

**Magma Totem** replaces **Searing Totem** once the fight starts (one Fire totem at a time): it burns everything within 8 yards for 73 Fire damage every 2 seconds, and **Trial by Fire** stretches it to 40 seconds, so about 4 or 5 a fight. It costs 650 mana: drop it at the boss's feet whenever it is down while you have a quarter of your mana; below that, **Searing Totem** fills the gap.

**Fire Nova** last: it erupts around your Fire totem, so keep the totem within 10 yards of the boss. **Trial by Fire** makes it 20% stronger on a 6-second cooldown; adding Fire Nova to the Enhancement list measured about 7% more damage in the rotation search.

**Elemental Devastation** turns every spell crit into 9% more melee crit chance for 10 seconds, which feeds **Flurry**: another reason to keep a shock going between swings. The five Restoration points are **Tidal Focus**: 5% more chance to hit.

Put **Windfury Weapon** on your weapon with a sharpening stone on top: in Forever an imbue and a stone stack, and **Elemental Weapons** makes the Windfury attacks 40% stronger. Keep it on: the re-tune of 2026-11-17 measured **Rockbiter Weapon** about 10% worse in a full raid.
caveats: No **Rage of the Farseer** in this build: use your trinkets and potion at the pull.

Mana: **Improved Stormstrike** and **Shamanistic Focus** pay for the shocks; with only your own buffs the simulator's build still runs short for part of a 3-minute fight. Use a mana potion when low, and do not hold shocks back.

Several targets: **Magma Totem** and **Fire Nova** hit every enemy within 8 and 10 yards of your Fire totem. You can have only one Fire totem out; **Totemic Call** brings it to you, with your other totems.
For a **Lightning Bolt** caster, play Elemental: this split is a melee build.

The page's full-raid number has no party **Windfury Totem**: in Forever your own **Windfury Weapon** switches it off for you (the imbue's tooltip), and since 2026-11-18 the simulator's full raid leaves it out for this build, which took about 12% off the number.
diverge: In the last 10 seconds, skip **Flame Shock** (its burn would not finish) and use **Earth Shock**.

In a party of warriors and rogues, ask whether they want **Windfury Totem** instead of **Grace of Air Totem**: you can keep only one Air totem down, and it does nothing for you while you use **Windfury Weapon**.
